about.subtitle: Passionate software developer with a focus on backend technologies and scalable solutions.
about.summary: Mohammed Owaish Khumar is a motivated and detail-oriented Software Developer with a B.Tech in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, currently working at Sportz Interactive. Skilled in backend development with C# and ASP.NET Core, RESTful API design, database/caching architecture, and containerized deployment. Experienced with JWT-based API authentication, Entity Framework/Dapper for data access, Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, and Agile/Scrum delivery. Helped scale a production fan-engagement platform to reliably serve 1.5-2M concurrent users through caching strategy and database query optimization. Passionate about leveraging strong analytical and technical skills to build scalable solutions, with a continuous commitment to learning and professional growth.
highlights: Backend development specialist with expertise in C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core
Experience building and securing RESTful APIs with JWT authentication and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation
Scaled a production platform to reliably serve 1.5-2M concurrent users via caching and query optimization
Hands-on with Docker containerization and CI/CD-driven release management (Jenkins, Spinnaker)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with quick adaptation to new technologies
Collaborative team player working in Agile/Scrum environments, with leadership experience

experience.title: Junior Associate Software Developer
experience.description: Designing and maintaining robust backend systems focusing on clean architecture, performance tuning, API security, and modular development.
responsibilities: Built and maintained backend applications for Fantasy, Quiz, Predictor, and Polling fan-engagement products across ten+ client engagements, including UEFA, The R&A (The Open Championship), World Surf League, ICC, Wisden, Scuderia Ferrari, AngelOne, KKR, European Athletics, and Gujarat Titans

Designed and implemented RESTful APIs in C# and ASP.NET Core/Web API for team management, league configuration, scoring, and authentication, using Entity Framework/Dapper for data access and JWT-based authentication to secure client-facing endpoints
Documented APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI to give client and internal teams a consistent, browsable reference for endpoint contracts
Built Worker Services for scheduled and background processing, and RabbitMQ consumers to ingest live sports data feeds for real-time scoring and leaderboard updates
Developed ASP.NET MVC administrative applications used daily by non-technical Operations teams to configure live games and manage content

Scaled the UEFA Fantasy platform to reliably serve 1.5-2M users by introducing a Redis/AWS ElastiCache caching layer and tuning PostgreSQL/Aurora RDS queries for high read concurrency during live match windows
Containerized backend services using Docker for consistent local development and testing environments
Managed CI/CD-driven release promotion across dev, staging, and production using Jenkins and Spinnaker, and monitored application health via AWS CloudWatch dashboards and structured logs
Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams (Product, QA, Design) in Agile/Scrum sprints to define requirements, resolve challenges, and deliver high-quality client experiences
Engineered the Quiz, Predictor, and Polling engines — configurable backend systems generating customized quiz, prediction, and voting experiences for client-specific sporting events
Built and deployed the interactive Hand Cricket game for Gujarat Titans, delivering a real-time one-on-one gameplay experience for mobile and web platforms

projects.title: Sports Fantasy Gaming Platform
projects.client: UEFA, The R&A (The Open Championship), World Surf League
projects.description: Built backend for team creation, league management, leaderboards, SSO authentication, and live scoring for each client, following a common architectural pattern. Extended the platform to support a combined men's and women's competition format for World Surf League, requiring schema and scoring-logic changes to handle dual-tournament state within a single fantasy league. Scaled deployments from 20K users (smaller clients) to 1.5-2M users (UEFA), with caching and query optimization as the primary levers for handling the difference in load.
features: Team creation, league management, and leaderboards
Live, real-time scoring via RabbitMQ data feeds
Combined men's and women's competition format (World Surf League)
Scaled to 1.5-2M concurrent users via Redis/ElastiCache caching and query optimization

Implemented Redis-backed real-time leaderboards and MVC administrative consoles giving each client's operations team direct control over question banks, prediction windows, and poll configuration without code changes.

MVC administrative consoles for non-technical operations teams
Client-specific question banks, prediction windows, and poll configuration

projects.description: Built a dynamic Blog Web Application utilizing Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. Implemented token-based authentication for secure user access, password hashing for data protection, and integrated image upload functionality using Multer for enhanced user interaction.

Integrated IoT sensors for temperature, humidity, and soil moisture detection; data was stored and retrieved from Firebase, enabling remote robot control and real-time data visualization.
